songs.title: Morning Road
songs.rawData:
Intro:
[Am] [F] [C] [G]
{chordbeats: 4 4 4 4}

Verse 1:
[Am]Gravel on the [F]early road
[C]Coffee in a [G]paper cup
[Am]Every mile a [F]little lighter
[C]Till the sun comes [G]up
{chordbeats: 4 4 4 4 4 4 4 4}

Chorus:
[F]Drive, drive, [C]morning road
[G]Take me where the [Am]rivers go
[F]Drive, drive, [C]nothing owed
[G]Only morning [G]road
{chordbeats: 4 4 4 4 4 4 4 4}

Verse 2:
[Am]Radio is [F]half asleep
[C]Humming every [G]song I know
[Am]Windows down and [F]nothing urgent
[C]Nowhere I must [G]go
{chordbeats: 4 4 4 4 4 4 4 4}

Outro:
[Am] [F] [C] [G]
[Am]
{chordbeats: 4 4 4 4 8}

songs.title: Paper Boats
songs.rawData:
Verse 1:
[C]Folding paper [G]in the rain
[Am]Writing names on [F]every sail
[C]Send them down the [G]gutter stream
[F]Watch them chase the [G]trail
{chordbeats: 4 4 4 4 4 4 4 4}

Chorus:
[F]Paper boats, [C]paper boats
[G]Carry what I [Am]couldn't say
[F]Paper boats, [G]float away
{chordbeats: 4 4 4 4 4 4}

Verse 2:
[C]One went under [G]by the bridge
[Am]One got tangled [F]in the weeds
[C]One kept going [G]round the bend
[F]Further than it [G]needs
{chordbeats: 4 4 4 4 4 4 4 4}

Chorus:
[F]Paper boats, [C]paper boats
[G]Carry what I [Am]couldn't say
[F]Paper boats, [G]float away, [C]float away
{chordbeats: 4 4 4 4 4 4 8}

songs.title: Slow Tide
songs.rawData:
Verse:
[D]Low tide, the [Bm]harbour sleeps
[G]Nets on the [A]wall
[D]Gulls in a [Bm]lazy line
[G]Waiting for [A]all
{chordbeats: 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3}

Bridge:
[G]Turn, turn, [A]water returns
[Bm]Slow as a [G]breath
{chordbeats: 3 3 3 3}

End:
[D]
{chordbeats: 6}
